questions.question: Appropriate technology is technology that:
options: Suits the needs, skills and resources of the people using it
Is always the most expensive available
Can only be used in rich countries

questions.question: Who wrote Small is Beautiful in 1973?
The Hippo Water Roller was invented in:
Why can a large combine harvester be inappropriate for a small farm on a steep slope?
options: The farmer cannot afford, run or repair it, and it does not suit the land

questions.question: Collecting and storing rain where it falls is called:
Zaï pits are:
options: Small planting pits filled with manure that catch rainwater

questions.question: Drip irrigation saves water because it:
options: Sprays water high into the air
Delivers water slowly and directly to plant roots

questions.question: How does mulching help in dry areas?
options: It makes soil hotter and drier
It reduces evaporation, keeps soil cool and stops weeds
It removes all water from soil

subtopics.title: Techniques for Soil and Pest Control

questions.question: Growing different crops in the same field in a planned sequence over seasons is:
Which plants add nitrogen to the soil through bacteria in root nodules?
options: Legumes such as beans and cowpeas

questions.question: In push-pull farming, desmodium:
options: Attracts stem borer moths to the maize
Repels stem borer moths and suppresses striga

questions.question: Why does intercropping spread risk for farmers?
options: If one crop fails, the others may still produce food
It makes farmers grow only one crop

subtopics.title: Small-Scale Farming and Food Gardens in South Africa, and the Error Museum

questions.question: Leafy indigenous vegetables such as amaranth are often called:
Airtight storage bags help farmers by:
options: Stopping insects from multiplying in stored grain

questions.question: Which statement is correct?
options: Appropriate technology means primitive tools only
Only large machines can increase yields
Crop rotation with legumes helps restore soil nutrients
Indigenous crops are not worth growing

questions.question: Why are indigenous crops important as the climate changes?
options: They need more water than maize
Many tolerate heat and drought better than maize

subtopics.title: The Right Key for the Lock

questions.question: In the Simplifier story, the "right key for the lock" means:
options: Tools must fit the people and place where they are used

questions.question: Yacouba Sawadogo's tools were:
Appropriate tools are:
options: Cheap and easy to fix with local materials

subtopics.title: A Bottle That Waters a Plant

questions.question: A buried plastic bottle with holes works like:
Covering soil with dry grass is called:
Water already used for washing that can water gardens is called:
Why does every drop count for South African farmers?
options: Rainfall is low and unreliable in most of the country
South Africa has too much rain
Farmers sell water to the sea

questions.question: The "three sisters" are:
In the three sisters, the beans:
options: Add natural fertiliser to the soil

questions.question: Changing crops each season helps because:
options: The soil does not get tired and pests do not settle in

questions.question: What is the main idea of this lesson?
options: Only expensive technology can grow food
Simple, suitable technologies and smart techniques help people grow more food sustainably
Farming should stop in dry countries
